profile.headline: Senior/Lead Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer · Distributed Systems · API Design & Backend Infrastructure · Ex-Google · Java, Kafka, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cut false positives by 20% for NO_DATA & LESS_THAN for SIEM, via lag-aware timers on async log event streaming pipelines.
Architected & Implemented GDPR Compliance scheduled job for customer-data deletion; removed 30M+ stale records, reclaiming ~300GB storage.
Defined real-time derived fields (Calculated Fields) on streaming logs.
Designed OOTB rule-editing API with conflict resolution across ~40K orgs.
Implemented Jaccard-similarity based smart suggestions to reduce alert noise using historical signal data.
Setup new Datacenter with 19 services.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Owned/Led Software Incubation - Data security project for self managed config tool. This reduces the onboarding process for new field/policy from 4-5 days to few minutes.
- Build backend in Go lang, and led teammates to follow the template with >90% test coverage and implemented monitoring (prometheus) and logging (splunk).
- Integrated with PostgreSQL DB and React UI. Deployed everything on AWS.
- Prepared POC for Dockerizing Go Backend + React UI in same docker container for easy deployments + make tool as single service.
- Prepared demo with the team and presented to leadership how this self managed tool reduced on boarding effort to 1-2 minutes.
- Build reusable Go binary to reduce code duplication (3 different places to 1 common place).
positions.insights: Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Apps Performance:
- Designed, Owned & implemented various components of the “Regressions prevention pipeline” A framework which identifies performance regressions during development(before production). It consists of: Metric recording, Metric Analysis, Alerting, Culprit finding, Triaging, Wind Tunnel(A/B tool with feature on/off), Effectiveness dashboards etc. 
   * The framework supports all 3 platforms (Desktop, Android, iOS). It is used for products like Editors(Docs/Sheets/Slides), Gmail, Calendar, Meet, Drive, Keep, etc.
- Designed & led project that improved initial load latency by ~250ms (on Docs - Android) using caching(snapshot) on client side. It involved in Android activity lifecycle, JSVM threading, database interactions in both JS and native code. 
   * Built monitoring dashboard using dremel(SQL like queries) & Google data studio (PLX).
   * Setup of a daily job for cache(snapshot) parity using FlumeJava, Rapid & Borg to identify anomalies in cache (client vs server).
- Owned & implemented project for improving initial load latency by ~100ms on Docs/Slides/Sheets(Android) by pushing back non-essential tasks during initial load of documents.

Google Wallet/Payments:
- Owned monitoring and alerting (using streamz & monarch) of various payments processing workflows. 
- Added monitoring coverage for various processing flows.
- Rewrote the framework with tests to easily and confidently add monitoring of new processes. End-to-End time to add new monitoring was reduced by at least 50%. Anyone with minimal guidance
- Setup monitoring of weekly/monthly scheduled jobs to minimize downtime from a few days to a few hours.
- Added error monitoring (third eye: daily reports with samples).
- Build query & automatized monthly report generation through borg job.
- Helped migrate legacy framework/systems to Google owned platform/systems (running payment processing flows on Google infrastructure & monitoring.
positions.insights: Google Data Studio, Core Java and +12 skills

positions.title: Architect System Developer
positions.description:
TxVia offers the most advanced processing systems for prepaid cards using the platform as a service approach(PAAS). “TxDev” offers a platform for processing a complete range of prepaid cards for the full scope of consumer, corporate and government applications.

Responsibilities:
-  Architecting and building a high performance tool “TxDev” & platform for prepaid card processing using Core Java, Swing, OSGi framework, Various design patterns and OO Concepts in a multithreaded environment.
- Designed & implemented major components of platform like:
   -  Improved compiler performance (Expression language -> Java class -> compile) by 40%.
   -  Search/index functionality(using Lucene API).
   -  Full VCS (using svnkit) with features like merge (custom three-way-merge algorithm), diff, remote repository browser etc.
   -  Implement Debugger (based on flow diagram & expression language).
   -  Developed various custom reusable swing components and layouts.

Environment: OSGi Framework, Java, AWT, Swing, JformDesigner, IntelliJ IDE, Git, Mac OS X
